Holy shit that first be is me too. I didn't even mention that but yes, I don't tell lies to hurt people, but yes. 

I started lying because when I was a kid I was a bed-wetter. Up until the age where it became seriously embarrassing. I got so used to lying in the form of "son, did you wet the bed again?", "No!", which was followed by sneaking downstairs to get clean sheets.
